snippet.title: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator - SWITCH 2 RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator is OUT NOW for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2!

Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

Rest assured, this isn’t a game about trading actual babies–we’re not monsters! Instead, players buy stocks based on the simulated lives of babies, profiting from their misery and cashing out the moment they win the Galactic Lottery. See? Nothing to worry about.

BUY NOW: 
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/StrangeScaffold
DISCORD: https://discordapp.com/invite/YySjWvM
